title: Chapter 293: Are You Trying To Mess With Me?
content:
Chapter 293: Are You Trying To Mess With Me?

"Why is this happening? No one takes action?"

The man in the scimitar was a little unbelievable.

With so many people, how could that guy make a safe breakthrough?

Hearing this, Lao Wu sighed, "Originally, a guy was going to succeed, but suddenly a more ruthless guy came out. Who do you think?"

Bang!

A crisp slap sounded.

The man in the scimitar said angrily: "Don't keep it fucking, tell me!"

"I, I said I said it was Lu Xue, and her nine-clawed dragon. They rescued that guy."

"Lu Xue, Nine-clawed Extreme Dragon!"

Hearing these two names, the scimitar man couldn't help but take two steps back.

Lu Xue doesn’t know what strength he has.

But the reputation of the Nine-Clawed Dragon is well-known.

That is an existence that can be crushed by the existence of the demon list in the same level.

Hiss ~

The man in the scimitar took a breath and suddenly became silent.

After a long time, a man stepped forward and said, "Boss, what should I do now?"

Hearing this, the scimitar boy said in a deep voice: "Look at the situation first. If Lu Xue did not come to compete for the ancient shield, after the two guys passed the tribulation, we would kill them and run away with the money. ”

"What if Lu Xue came over?"

"Run straight."

The man with scimitar said expressionlessly.

He is not a fool to compete with the Nine-Clawed Dragon.

Hearing the man with scimitar, no one objected.

After all, the strength is here.

At the same time, the rest of the people around them also made their own choices.

Some people chose to leave.

Get out of the dispute.

And the remaining people who did not leave obviously chose to take a gamble.

At this moment, a cool breath came.

The next moment, a figure in blue appeared in front of Qin Feng and Xiao Luo.

"Is it okay?"

"Sister Xue!"

When they saw Lu Xue, they looked very happy.

The rest of the people around him looked extremely ugly.

The next moment, the space trembled.

Several figures retreated directly without hesitation.

In the distance, "Boss, that Lu Xue is in the same group as them."

At this time, the scimitar boy's face was distorted.

"withdraw!"

As soon as the words fell, the six people also retreated.

Lu Xue and his group are undoubtedly the absolute overlords on the periphery of the ancient battlefield.

No force dares to confront them head-on.

"Sister Xue, this ancient shield is strange."

"We two of us first came into contact with this ancient shield and attracted the heavenly tribulation."

Xiao Luo said anxiously.

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked at the ancient shield in Qin Feng's hand.

"show me."

"Sister Xue, aren't you afraid of the Emperor's Tribulation?"

"I'm afraid of it, I'm the Immortal Lord Realm!"

"Well, that's right."

Immediately, Qin Feng handed the ancient shield in his hand to Lu Xue.

The next moment.

Boom!

Another terrifying cloud of disaster emerged from the void.

......

The scene was silent for a moment.

"???"

"You fuck me, right?"

Lu Xue smashed the ancient shield in her hand to the ground, and then took out the Xuanyuan Sword and pressed it on the ancient shield in anger.

She is the Immortal Lord Realm.

Is it so excessive to attract the Emperor's Tribulation?

"Broken shield, you'd better give me an explanation, otherwise don't blame my aunt for ruining you!"

A terrifying chill overflowed from Lu Xue's body.

Xiao Luo and the others on the side were trembling.

This was the first time that the two of them saw Lu Xue so angry.

No wonder.

If the two of them were in the realm of the Immortal Lords, they would probably just spit out the sky and the earth, and curse all the eight generations of ancestors of God.

But at this moment, it is obviously not God who is at work.

Buzz —

I saw that the ancient shield trembled slightly.

Obviously, this ancient shield has a spirit.

Scream!

The Xuanyuan Sword pierced through the ancient shield with one sword.

The next moment, an illusory old man slowly emerged from ancient shields.

"Wait, wait a moment, I'm good!"

"You can get my inheritance through the imperial tribulation."

The old man quickly spoke.

It can be seen that the old man was very afraid of the Xuanyuan Sword in Lu Xue's hand.

After all, this is the most treasure of the Human Emperor Palace back then, a treasure representing the fortune of the human race.

He was even upgraded by Lu Daosheng himself.

Now I don’t know what level it is.

How can a mere shabby shield be compared with the Xuanyuan Sword?

"Inheritance? Don't fart, you are the spirit of this shield. Do you think I can't see it?"

Lu Xue gritted her teeth and said.

As soon as these words came out, the old man's face changed.

"How did you know about it?"

The old man in front of him was the spirit transformed by this ancient shield.

I just don’t know if it was the original spirit, or the spirit that was destroyed after the war and condensed again.

Seeing that his identity had been exposed, the old man continued, "Okay, I am indeed a spirit, little girl, you have passed my test. From now on, you will be my next master."

After saying that, the old man was about to approach Lu Xue.

Buzz —

The sound of the sword sounded, and the Xuanyuan Sword automatically floated in front of Lu Xue, blocking the shield spirit.

And the sword energy is directly aimed at the shield spirit.

This shield spirit is very dishonest.

"Xiaoqing!"

Lu Xue shouted coldly.

Ao Qing immediately appeared in front of Lu Xue.

"My Lord, what are your instructions?"

Lu Xue pointed coldly at the shield spirit in front of her, "Give me this guy a meal."

"yes!"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Ao Qing opened his bloody mouth without any hesitation.

Since this shield spirit is so dishonest, it is useless to keep it.

But the shield spirit was a little confused.

"You, you want to ruin me, dream! Wait until it turns into my nutrients!"

Thunder suddenly started.

A stream of power of heaven and earth emerged from ancient shields.

Obviously, this ancient shield does have two tricks, which can really lead to the imperial disaster.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue snorted coldly.

The next moment, the Xuanyuan Sword was slashed out.

Cut iron like mud.

The entire ancient shield was completely divided into two.

Immediately afterwards, Gu Dun was swallowed into his mouth by Ao Qing.

"ah!!"

The screams were accompanied by the creaking chewing sound.

After a moment, the scene gradually returned to quiet.

"Solved?!"

Qin Feng was both surprised and happy, and quickly looked up at the void.

I saw that a cloud of disaster began to slowly dissipate.

"It really dissipated!"

On the side, Xiao Luo also had a smile on his face, but the next moment, he suddenly felt something was wrong.

"Wait a minute! Only one dissipated!"

"Um?!"

In the void, a cloud of disaster slowly dissipated, and the remaining two did not dissipate, but became stronger.

Inside, thunder rolled.

The Emperor's Tribulation is coming!

It turned out that what had disappeared was Lu Xue's disaster cloud.

"Fuck, I've been cheated!"

"Sister Xue, what should I do!"

Qin Feng and Xiao Luo looked nervous and quickly turned to Lu Xue for help.

Hearing this, Lu Xue spread her hands and said helplessly: "I really have no choice but to do this. You two can only rely on yourself."

At this time, Ao Qing came up.

"My little master, some teeth are chewy, not delicious."

"Okay, OK, I'll give you something delicious next time."

Lu Xue touched Ao Qing and then took Ao Qing away from the two of them.

The Emperor's Tribulation is coming.

She doesn't want to be affected.

"Oh by the way, I advise you two to stay away, otherwise the power of the Emperor's Tribulation may be doubled."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng looked at each other and thought suddenly.

The next moment, the two of them rushed in the opposite direction.
